subject: AS A RESPONSE MEASURE TO THE DECISION OF THE AVIATION AUTHORITIES
text:
U1174/26 NOTAMR U0725/26
Q)UUWV/QOAXX/IV/BO/A/000/999/5535N03716E999
A)UUUU B)2609010630 C)2612012359 EST
E)AS A RESPONSE MEASURE TO THE DECISION OF THE AVIATION AUTHORITIES
OF FINLAND STIPULATING THAT ALL ACFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR OPERATED,
OR OTHERWISE CONTROLLED BY CITIZENS OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION AND
ALL OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR CERTIFICATE (AOC) ISSUED BY THE
RUSSIAN FEDERATION AUTHORITIES ARE PROHIBITED FROM TAKE-OFF,
LANDING OR OVERFLYING FINLAND, AIP SUP 022/2024, THE AVIATION
AUTHORITIES OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION HEREBY INFORM THAT ALL
AIRCRAFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR OPERATED, OR OTHERWISE CONTROLLED BY
CITIZENS OF FINLAND ARE PROHIBITED FROM OVERFLYING THE AIRSPACE OF
THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION, EXCEPT FOR EMERGENCY, HUM, SAR, MEDICAL
FLIGHTS AND ACFT WITH PERMISSION FOR FLIGHTS GRANTED BY THE FEDERAL
AIR TRANSPORT AGENCY OR THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF THE
RUSSIAN FEDERATION, AS APPROPRIATE.
